decisions.reason: The online customer portal is a visible infrastructure investment tied to the firm's digital service direction, and its sunk development costs and public announcement make abandonment within a year unlikely.
Winning the Deutscher Verpackungspreis 2024 is a strong public commitment and validation, so management will persist with and promote this packaging display solution.

Presented on its own page as part of the core display range, the quarter-pallet pegboard display fits the firm's established direction, and any weak early sales can be attributed to the 2024 retail downturn.
The small counter display is a low-cost extension of the core display business with a dedicated web presence, so management will keep it and explain modest results as temporary.

The large freestanding information display is publicly showcased and central to the display portfolio, so despite the risk of niche demand, management is likely to persist rather than admit a misjudgment after one year.
